summary: Complete testing of Path Debugger (Sistema de depurador de rutas) for LOTR 5e RPG. All 16 backend tests passed. All 6 frontend features verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing locations and roads data for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Path Debugger at /path-debugger is fully functional. Backend endpoint POST /api/travel/debug-pathfinding accepts origen_nombre, destino_nombre, paso_km, preferir_caminos, evitar_tierras_oscuras, evitar_tierras_sombra, max_pasos. Returns pasos array with decision types: INICIO, SEGUIR_CAMINO, IR_A_CAMINO, CAMPO_TRAVES, EVITAR, LLEGADA. Each step includes posicion, terreno, tipo_tierra, razon, and optionally alternativas_descartadas.

F1_debug_pathfinding_endpoint_returns_st.evidence: All 12 backend tests for debug-pathfinding passed including response structure, decision types, configuration echo, and error handling

F2_frontend_loads_and_shows_map.description: PathDebugger page loads and displays Middle Earth map
F2_frontend_loads_and_shows_map.evidence: Screenshot shows 'La Tierra Media' map with roads rendered, zoom controls at 5%, header 'DEPURADOR DE RUTAS'

F3_origin_destination_selection_works.description: Select dropdowns allow choosing origin and destination locations
F3_origin_destination_selection_works.evidence: Successfully selected 'Minas Tirith' as origin and 'Pelargir' as destination via Select components

F4_analizar_button_executes_analysis.description: Clicking 'Analizar' button runs the pathfinding analysis and shows results
F4_analizar_button_executes_analysis.evidence: Analysis completed showing 17 pasos, 149.7 km total, Resumen card appeared, toast notification 'Análisis completado: 30 pasos'

F5_step_navigation_buttons_work.description: < and > buttons navigate between analysis steps
F5_step_navigation_buttons_work.evidence: Navigated from 'Paso 1 de 17' to 'Paso 4 de 17' using next button, then back to 'Paso 3 de 17' using prev button

F6_alternativas_descartadas_displayed.description: When alternatives are considered and rejected, they are shown in the step details
F6_alternativas_descartadas_displayed.evidence: Screenshot shows 'Alternativas descartadas:' section with two entries: 'El camino Gran camino del Oeste no nos acerca más al destino' and 'Evitamos Gran camino del Oeste (salimos hace 0 pasos)'

ui_elements_verified.configuration_card: Configuración del Análisis with Origen/Destino selects, Paso (km) input, Preferir caminos switch, Evitar Tierras de Sombra switch, Evitar Tierras Oscuras switch
